recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No further core source change is needed for FHIR-26930 unless a future FM decision reopens the broader Claim-family productOrService model.
issue_request: FHIR-26930 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by Financial Management. It asked to change .productOrService in Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit from 1..1 to 0..1 because prior authorization can be identified by revenue or category code without a product/service billing code.
initial_application: No current source-history commit explicitly tagged FHIR-26930 was found. The substantive change appears to have been applied in the generic git ab2681b694a3266efb963db72fb64be8a6dab82b FHIR core update, which changed Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit productOrService minima from 1 to 0 across the Claim-family definitions while also adding related revenue-code elements.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit as active approved core resources. FHIR-30333 later broadened the same optionality/comment family across Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 620368e30f167ef83caaa74e476d513996fe2fd6. FHIR-30508 is the adjacent ClaimResponse/EOB addItem revenue and productOrService optionality issue and was audited separately in this run. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active StructureDefinition sources already carry min value="0" and max value="1" for the relevant Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit productOrService elements, satisfying the published FHIR-26930 decision.
